messages:
Maya Kaur: quick one — spotted a few confusing bits in the Audit Log UI during the compliance review. putting them here so we can pick priors.

Maya Kaur: 1) KMS/key display: we currently render entries like `key=alias/redwood-prod-1`. looks too technical and reads like raw creds. customers asked if that could be labeled better (e.g., "KMS key alias: redwood-prod-1") and possibly redact the middle?

Maya Kaur: 2) timestamp ordering: the table defaults to ascending by timestamp (oldest first). for audit views we should default to newest-first and show sort affordance.

Maya Kaur: 3) retention column copy: shows "90" which confused PMs — they expected "90 days" and a tooltip about deletion vs archive.

Maya Kaur: tagging @design @oliver for quick UX/dev take.

Oliver Chen: +1 re: newest-first. surprised that slipped. small fix — flip default sort and add an aria-sort on the header so screen readers announce it.

Oliver Chen: for the KMS text, I'd prefer: "KMS key alias: redwood-prod-1" (no `key=`). also append a subtle "(last 4 chars shown)" when we redact eg `redwood-****-1`?

Priya Singh: agree with labeling. also suggest clickable copy to show full key in a modal for admins with permission, instead of inline full string. reduces visual noise.

Jorge Alvarez: retention column: show humanized value "90 days" and on hover: "Data is deleted after 90 days. Retention applies to request and response logs; some fields may be redacted." Link to docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/retention-policy (placeholder).

Maya Kaur: thanks. can we change header names too? Current headers: Timestamp | Event | Details | Key. Proposed: Time (local) | Event | Details | KMS key (alias) | Retention

Oliver Chen: one more: make sure Time shows timezone or local offset. sample: `2026-03-04 09:12:33 PST` or `2026-03-04 17:12:33 +00:00` depending on user locale.

Priya Singh: accessibility nits: sort buttons need role=button + title, and the KMS cell should have accessible label explaining redaction like: "KMS key alias, partially redacted" so screen readers don't read masked characters as punctuation.

accessibility-bot: Automation note — recommended aria-label: "KMS key alias, partially redacted; press Enter to view full key if permitted."

design-bot: Design suggestion — show a small key icon then the alias text; hover reveals full name modal. use monospaced font for alias. also color for redaction (lighter gray) to indicate masked portion.

Maya Kaur: copy suggestion for audit event phrasing: instead of "Key rotated" use "KMS key rotated" or "Customer KMS key rotated" to avoid ambiguity with app keys. also prefer passive->active wording: "KMS key rotated by Priya.S" vs "Key rotation performed"

Jorge Alvarez: +1 on specificity. and add event compactness: event details should be one-line summary with a link to expanded JSON for full context.

Oliver Chen: implementation notes for eng-runtime: keep storage of raw key alias in logs, but send masked alias to UI by default. add API param `show_full_kms=true` gated by scope.

Maya Kaur: ok next steps: Oliver to update default sort + timestamp format. Design to mock minified KMS cell + modal. Priya to draft the new copy for event messages and retention tooltip. Jorge to add doc link and confirm policy text. accessibility-bot will provide aria strings.

Priya Singh: I'll post copy PR by EOD and include a few example event messages for localization checks.

Oliver Chen: I'll do a tiny PR for sort + timezone rendering tomorrow.

Maya Kaur: awesome — thanks all. leaving this thread open for any last UX edge cases. :thumbsup:

Jorge Alvarez: one edge — region+KMS linkage: if a key is multi-region, show a small pill e.g. "multi-region"; else show region code. small UX win for compliance teams.

Maya Kaur: love that. add to mock list.

accessibility-bot: Check contrast for redaction gray and ensure focus ring on modal trigger is 3px solid (meets AA).

Maya Kaur: noted. closing on action items, will follow up with screenshots in a new thread once design mock is ready.
